title: Your New Life as a Hucow (Standard F4F)
description: In this file I thought I would try something a little bit special. Way back when I first heard of the term "hucow" I honestly really didn't know much about the fantasy. Despite my naivety, out of it spawned the delightfully quaint filee "Udderly Entranced" featuring a mountain drive induction that still gets referenced to this day. Well, now that I have a lot more experience under my belt I thought it was about time I revisited the idea with "Your New Life as a Hucow" So, relax for me as I remould and reshape you into my lovely, mooing, perfect cow girl. You'll get to walk on all fours... You'll get milked... And I bet it'll feel so good you might just erupt... I see you are already naked... Good. You've wanted this for a long time haven't you? To leave it all behind and live under me, to shed all the burdens of normal life and become my livestock. To become a Hucow. Living to be milked and taken care of. Is that what you want? Perfect. Moo for me, my good pet!
author: Mistress Shibby
